selection_rule: No automatic winner, no parameter/default/source changes, no added or replacement seeds/runs. Preserve every failed/interrupted attempt; never use survivor means as acceptance.
core_gate: Every seed and every asset: finite positive prices/values, zero caps, relative cash and maximum absolute per-asset share errors <=1e-8, all nine finite moments, kurtosis>0 and abs-return ACF1>0. Empirical acceptance remains pending.
return_definition: Simple price returns expm1(diff(log(price))), 2500 observations after 1000-day burn-in; dividends excluded from return moments but included in cash reconstruction.
source_scope: M1 execution, validation, moments, hashing and process tuning dependencies; unused Stage1 implementations and disclosure game/metrics/report/experiment sources are not core drift gates.

memory_equivalence.statement: E0=0 and memory=1 imply Et=0; surprise equals flow/depth. Transient state still decays at the unchanged coefficient.
memory_equivalence.probe_scope: Four deterministic book updates; no additional full-market simulation.

target.nature: Existing training target, previously used to fit seven M1 defaults; deliberately reused for comparable development diagnostics. Not untouched/held-out data.
target.provenance: French49 29 training industries, 6539 daily observations, 2000-2025; cached target created by abm.msm empirical_target with circular-block bootstrap defaults (block20, draws200, seed20261011). No empirical target is recomputed.
target.unit_limitation: French49 observations are SIC industry portfolios; model assets are interpreted as single companies. Averaging company-asset moments is not portfolio construction or individual-stock empirical calibration.
target.score_limitation: Original target SEs describe 6539-day industry histories, not this 2500-day company panel. Normalized deviations/J are descriptive legacy diagnostics, not calibrated significance tests or release gates. Old M1 fit used 40 sampled assets, this comparison uses all 200.

sealed_data_access: Only the cached target_train.json is loaded; no raw empirical dataset, validation/test target, sealed test execution or formal 20261101..20261130 seeds are used.
